far_near_vs_copy.what: ln far/near zone/ref (zone follows zone reflectors, ref above+below) against ln |copy coefficient on near|

far_near_refbelow_vs_copy.what: same, reference below only (does not contain the copy source)

far_near_followstrong_vs_copy.what: same, zone window follows the strong reflector

near_level_vs_copy.what: ln near zone/ref against ln |copy| (power check: multiples must give a positive relation)

far_near_vs_rho.what: ln far/near zone/ref against ln |copy correlation on near|

extrapolation_to_zero_copy_ref_ab.model: ln(far/near zone/ref) = a + b*|copy coefficient|; value at zero copy = exp(a)

extrapolation_to_zero_copy_ref_b.model: ln(far/near zone/ref) = a + b*|copy coefficient|; value at zero copy = exp(a)

independent_halves_selection.what: blocks grouped by the copy coefficient of one half of each block; far/near zone/ref measured on the other half (plain energies of that half); mean of the two ways

far_mid_vs_copy.what: ln far/mid zone/ref against ln |copy on near| (near's zone energy is not in this ratio)

mid_level_refbelow_vs_copy.what: ln mid zone/ref(below) against ln |copy on near| (mid is independent data)

extrapolation_to_zero_copy_independent_h.what: as extrapolation_to_zero_copy_ref_ab, but the copy coefficient comes from one half of each block and far/near from the other half

test1.slope_expected: 0 if the minimum follows the strong reflectors (multiples), 1 if it follows the zone reflectors (clay)
